update_log.summary: Pre-launch media impressions collected. No end-user reviews available — product ships June 2026. Overall sentiment positive. Key concern: right-hand only design and cushion value vs M840L.

SIGNIFICANT: M850L now on sale in China at ¥319 (to-hand ¥280.72) — product has launched ahead of 'June 2026' global date. M840L Amazon listing live (ASIN B0GSJ4YZTN). Three new media reviews: Cult of Mac (4/5), Senses.se (mixed — critical ergonomic finding: cushion doesn't reach palm for larger-handed users), The Point Online (positive hands-on). No end-user buyer reviews yet. Sentiment score adjusted to 7.5 due to emerging concern about cushion effectiveness for larger hands.

FIRST REAL BUYER REVIEWS captured via Firecrawl stealth scrape. M850L: 4.6★ from 11 ratings (5 written reviews); M840L: 4.4★ from 14 ratings (3 written reviews). Praise: comfort, genuinely silent clicks, seamless numbered 3-device Bluetooth switching, 24-month battery. Complaints: no USB receiver in the box / Bluetooth-only connectivity blips, M840L too lightweight for some, and at ~$50 some buyers expect rechargeable rather than AA. Buyer sentiment strongly positive overall (avg ≈4.5★). Status moved to post-launch; sentiment score raised to 8.0. JD.com/Taobao Chinese buyer comments remain behind login/anti-bot.
